hints.title: Subtractive Numeral Pair Inversion
hints.text: Roman numerals are typically written largest to smallest. When a smaller symbol precedes a larger one, how does that change the sign of its numeric contribution?

hints.title: Lookahead Subtraction Contribution Invariant
hints.text: If the value of symbol at index i is strictly less than the symbol at index i + 1, its value is subtracted rather than added.

hints.title: Single Pass Value Evaluation Procedure
hints.text: Create mapping from Roman characters to integer values. Iterate through the string from left to right: if current value is smaller than next character value, subtract it from total. Otherwise add it to total. Add final character value and return total.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Parsing substrings with complex regexes creates unnecessary allocation overhead when single-pass lookahead suffices.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A single traversal evaluates the string in O(N) time with O(1) auxiliary symbol mapping storage.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle the six standard subtraction instances (IV, IX, XL, XC, CD, CM) naturally via lookahead.
